subject.title: fix(agents): decouple MCP retirement from browser cleanup

question: Should `OpenClawPluginToolContext.runId` become the supported generic per-run ownership key for plugin-managed ephemeral resources, or should this browser cleanup fix use a narrower browser-specific seam?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent and additive, but it permanently expands the public Plugin SDK for a capability currently consumed by one bundled plugin; repository policy requires maintainer intent for that contract boundary.

options.title: Approve opaque run ownership
options.body: Accept the documented optional `runId` contract, then require real browser proof and a clean rebase before merge.

options.title: Narrow the browser seam
options.body: Keep run ownership inside the browser-specific context or lifecycle API so unrelated plugins do not receive a new generic contract.

options.title: Pause the broader refactor
options.body: Retain current behavior until a smaller decoupling design can avoid the public SDK and cross-module ownership expansion.

recommendation.title: Approve opaque run ownership
recommendation.body: Accept the documented optional `runId` contract, then require real browser proof and a clean rebase before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history spans subagent lifecycle, MCP retirement, and the core-to-plugin contract boundary, with substantial recent ownership by this contributor.
